scope: Numerical sanity subset of unit_test_suite.json. One primary case per coverable kernel, deduplicated across shared coverage. Includes compute, dataflow helper callers and the 17 manual auxiliary readers.
selection_notes: Each group selects exactly one parametrized Python case or one named C++ GTest. {arch} is only the pytest silicon architecture fixture; every shape/dtype/strategy parameter is fixed.
One primary case is assigned per covered inventory kernel. Other cases may execute it incidentally; coverage is per source kernel, not every compile-time variant or helper call site.
Cases with no executable test path remain gaps. No validation-only, golden-only, performance-only or disabled tests are counted as kernel coverage.
Existing test bodies can make multiple op calls, including the Moreh callback tests and inline example tile-count loops. These count as one pytest case, not one device launch.
The runner pins supported environment controls for the inline examples and DiT correctness sweep. A skip, xfail, missing case or unexpected case count fails an execution run.
Common is a single-device lane shared by Wormhole/Blackhole in source; it is not a claim of verification on every device SKU, core grid or debug configuration.
Selection is based on factory routing and test source review. Collection is validated separately; no on-device compilation or numerical execution is claimed.
